_meta.about: English unit names that the original EBOOT already has in ASCII (lock-on labels, unit lists). Each row replaces the string in place at its file offset; the new name must fit the old slot. Applied by tools/eboot_ascii_fix.py. Only names that clash with the glossary are listed; CALL_VAJURA is an internal identifier and stays. Also the Nyan-Nyan Shop price unit: the game draws the 'Nyan' kanji, p and t as three strings at fixed x (+0x93, +0x9C, +0xA0, size 10); the English 'pts' is the 'Nyan' kanji string (u3025) and the p and t strings are emptied here.
